title: Wendle
description: As a coordinator on At Attin, Wendle was a diligent worker who worked extremely long hours. Because of his grueling work schedule, it meant his son, Wim, spent a lot of unsupervised time home alone, playing with his toys and daydreaming of adventures that he would go on. When Wendle got home late one night and found Wim gone, he chased after his son and arrived in time to see him blasting off in a starship.
